value.rationale: This is the exact first-prime characteristic boundary where a classical shuffle/left-regular-band regular module becomes nonsemisimple. It gives the complete modular Jordan form simultaneously for all primes, distinguishes the regular algebra module from chamber-only walks and invariant subalgebra, and identifies the unique extension by a canonical rank-one nilpotent. These are natural structural invariants, not arbitrary finite parameters or a routine table lookup.
